headline: Iran's IRGC says it attacked two US vessels, eight oil tankers
summary: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed it attacked two US vessels and eight oil tankers in the Persian Gulf, in retaliation for a US action. The report was not independently confirmed in the input.
why: The Persian Gulf carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so attacks on tankers and naval vessels raise supply and insurance risk for crude markets.
why_moved: The claimed attacks on vessels in the Persian Gulf add to supply and shipping risk for oil flows through the region.
